name: Texmelucan

queries.query: Texmelucan Mexico official cadastral parcels map San Martín Texmelucan Puebla
queries.result: First-party discovery located the official municipal cadastral-service pages, the municipal cadastral regulation catalog, the municipal cartography/procedure documents, and the Puebla state Geoportal/map catalog. The municipal sources establish a local cadastre and cartography function; the state viewer is general geographic dissemination and did not expose a safe anonymous parcel-vector response in the inspected public surface.

queries.query: San Martín Texmelucan catastro parcelas mapa cartografía catastral sitio oficial
queries.result: Fuentes oficiales municipales identifican a la Tesorería Municipal/Dirección de Catastro como responsable del registro catastral, avalúo y cartografía; la Gaceta y el manual describen una geobase, polígonos, coordenadas UTM, clave catastral y cuenta predial. El portal estatal ofrece mapas y un visor geográfico, pero no se obtuvo una respuesta pública anónima con identidad nativa de parcela y geometría completa.

registryEvidence.custodian: Tesorería Municipal / Dirección de Catastro of San Martín Texmelucan is the evidenced local cadastral custodian. Municipal Gaceta assigns cartography/geobase, cadastral valuation, and geographic-information access functions to municipal cadastral units.
registryEvidence.scope: Local municipal fiscal cadastre and cartography are evidenced by official procedures and regulation. The Puebla state SEI/Geoportal is a general state geographic-information viewer, not the local cadastral custodian.

parcelDiscovery.source: Official municipal cadastral procedures and Puebla state public geographic viewers were reviewed; no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-full-geometry response was qualified.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 official municipal procedure page. It names Tesorería Municipal/Dirección de Catastro, describes registration of physical/legal/graphic/administrative/technical parcel data, and exposes no public parcel API or downloadable geometry.

HTTP 200 official municipal cadastral appraisal page. It documents cadastral-key and predial-account assignment, but requires a property document/inspection and provides no anonymous parcel-vector endpoint.

Official municipal Gaceta text documents the Cartografía Municipal department, cadastral geobase, parcel polygons, and controlled access to cadastral geographic information. No public schema or geometry response was returned.

Official municipal procedure PDF documents identifying a parcel by UTM position, editing its polygon, assigning clave catastral/cuenta predial, and producing a location plan. It is procedural evidence, not a public parcel download/API. No raw personal or ownership fields were requested or retained.
Official Puebla map catalog lists San Martín Texmelucan and a microrregion map, but the exposed catalog is general cartography and did not provide parcel identities/geometries.

Official state Geoportal rendered a public geographic viewer with layers, municipality search, coordinate tools, and login link. Local curl from the research environment failed to connect (connection failure); the public rendered page was inspected through first-party web retrieval. No cadastral parcel layer, schema, CRS, or bounded ID-plus-geometry response was exposed. No login or private route probing was attempted.

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as an absence test. No exact-point parcel query was issued because no public parcel endpoint was exposed. A map extent miss, connection failure, or absent public layer is not evidence of citywide absence.

uncertainty: Municipal cadastral geobase and polygon workflow are evidenced, but current anonymous service access, native ID schema, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unresolved.
The state Geoportal may expose additional layers through its client after dynamic loading or authorized access; no credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or private token was used.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No sample GeoJSON was written because no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was returned.
Packet completion is not source integration or runtime admission.
